component.name: Whatsie
component.summary: WhatsApp Web desktop client built with Qt WebEngine

description.p: Whatsie is a lightweight desktop client for WhatsApp Web. It keeps WhatsApp in its own window with native desktop notifications, a system-tray unread badge, light/dark themes, zoom, downloads, and voice, video and screen-share calls.
From-scratch Qt 6.11 rewrite: notifications, downloads, theme, zoom, calls and screen sharing.
